verses.textZh: 我这作长老的，写信给蒙拣选的夫人和她的儿女。你们是我在真理中所爱的；不单是我，凡认识真理的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我这作长老的，写信给蒙拣选的夫人和她的儿女。你们是我在真理中所爱的；不单是我，凡认识真理的，
verses.textZhCuv: 作长老的写信给蒙拣选的太太 和她的儿女，就是我诚心所爱的；不但我爱，也是一切知道真理之人所爱的。
verses.textEnNiv: The elder, To the lady chosen by God and to her children, whom I love in the truth—and not I only, but also all who know the truth—
verses.textEnEsv: The elder to the elect lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not only I, but also all who know the truth,
verses.textEnNkjv: The Elder, To the elect lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not only I, but also all those who have known the truth,
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from John, the elder. I am writing to the chosen lady and to her children, whom I love in the truth—as does everyone else who knows the truth—
verses.textEnNasb: The elder to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth; and not only I, but also all who know the truth,
verses.textEn: The elder, To the lady chosen by God and to her children, whom I love in the truth—and not I only, but also all who know the truth—

verses.textZh: 也因为真理的缘故爱你们。这真理在我们里面，也必与我们同在，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也因为真理的缘故爱你们。这真理在我们里面，也必与我们同在，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 爱你们是为真理的缘故，这真理存在我们里面，也必永远与我们同在。
verses.textEnNiv: because of the truth, which lives in us and will be with us forever:
verses.textEnEsv: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:
verses.textEnNkjv: because of the truth which abides in us and will be with us forever:
verses.textEnNlt: because the truth lives in us and will be with us forever.
verses.textEnNasb: because of the truth which remains in us and will be with us forever:
verses.textEn: because of the truth, which lives in us and will be with us forever:

verses.textZh: 愿恩惠、怜悯、平安，从父神和他儿子耶稣基督在真理和爱中与我们同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿恩惠、怜悯、平安，从父神和他儿子耶稣基督在真理和爱中与我们同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 恩惠、怜悯、平安从父神和他儿子耶稣基督在真理和爱心上必常与我们同在！
verses.textEnNiv: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Father’s Son, will be with us in truth and love.
verses.textEnEsv: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from Jesus Christ the Father’s Son, in truth and love.
verses.textEnNkjv: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with you from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
verses.textEnNlt: Grace, mercy, and peace, which come from God the Father and from Jesus Christ—the Son of the Father—will continue to be with us who live in truth and love.
verses.textEnNasb: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
verses.textEn: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Father’s Son, will be with us in truth and love.

verses.textZh: 我看见你的儿女中，有人照着我们从父领受的命令在真理中行事，我就非常欣慰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看见你的儿女中，有人照着我们从父领受的命令在真理中行事，我就非常欣慰。
verses.textZhCuv: 我见你的儿女，有照我们从父所受之命令遵行真理的，就甚欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: It has given me great joy to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father commanded us.
verses.textEnEsv: I rejoiced greatly to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as we were commanded by the Father.
verses.textEnNkjv: I rejoiced greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, as we received commandment from the Father.
verses.textEnNlt: How happy I was to meet some of your children and find them living according to the truth, just as the Father commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: I was overjoyed to find some of your children walking in truth, just as we have received a commandment to do from the Father.
verses.textEn: It has given me great joy to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father commanded us.

verses.textZh: 夫人哪，我现在请求你，我们要彼此相爱。我写给你的，不是一条新命令，而是我们从起初就有的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 夫人哪，我现在请求你，我们要彼此相爱。我写给你的，不是一条新命令，而是我们从起初就有的。
verses.textZhCuv: 太太啊，我现在劝你，我们大家要彼此相爱。这并不是我写一条新命令给你，乃是我们从起初所受的命令。
verses.textEnNiv: And now, dear lady, I am not writing you a new command but one we have had from the beginning. I ask that we love one another.
verses.textEnEsv: And now I ask you, dear lady— not as though I were writing you a new commandment, but the one we have had from the beginning— that we love one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now I plead with you, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment to you, but that which we have had from the beginning: that we love one another.
verses.textEnNlt: I am writing to remind you, dear friends, that we should love one another. This is not a new commandment, but one we have had from the beginning.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I ask you, lady, not as though I were writing to you a new commandment, but the one which we have had from the beginning, that we love one another.
verses.textEn: And now, dear lady, I am not writing you a new command but one we have had from the beginning. I ask that we love one another.

verses.textZh: 我们要照着他的命令行事，这就是爱。你们从起初所听见的那命令，就是要你们凭着爱心行事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们要照着他的命令行事，这就是爱。你们从起初所听见的那命令，就是要你们凭着爱心行事。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若照他的命令行，这就是爱。你们从起初所听见当行的，就是这命令。
verses.textEnNiv: And this is love: that we walk in obedience to his commands. As you have heard from the beginning, his command is that you walk in love.
verses.textEnEsv: And this is love, that we walk according to his commandments; this is the commandment, just as you have heard from the beginning, so that you should walk in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the commandment, that as you have heard from the beginning, you should walk in it.
verses.textEnNlt: Love means doing what God has commanded us, and he has commanded us to love one another, just as you heard from the beginning.
verses.textEnNasb: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the commandment, just as you have heard from the beginning, that you are to walk in it.
verses.textEn: And this is love: that we walk in obedience to his commands. As you have heard from the beginning, his command is that you walk in love.

verses.textZh: 有许多欺骗人的已经在世上出现，他们否认耶稣基督是成了肉身来的；这就是那骗人的和敌基督的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有许多欺骗人的已经在世上出现，他们否认耶稣基督是成了肉身来的；这就是那骗人的和敌基督的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为世上有许多迷惑人的出来，他们不认耶稣基督是成了肉身来的；这就是那迷惑人、敌基督的。
verses.textEnNiv: I say this because many deceivers, who do not acknowledge Jesus Christ as coming in the flesh, have gone out into the world. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.
verses.textEnEsv: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who do not confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. Such a one is the deceiver and the antichrist.
verses.textEnNkjv: For many deceivers have gone out into the world who do not confess Jesus Christ as coming in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
verses.textEnNlt: I say this because many deceivers have gone out into the world. They deny that Jesus Christ came in a real body. Such a person is a deceiver and an antichrist.
verses.textEnNasb: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who do not acknowledge Jesus Christ as coming in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the antichrist.
verses.textEn: I say this because many deceivers, who do not acknowledge Jesus Christ as coming in the flesh, have gone out into the world. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.

verses.textZh: 你们要小心，不要拆毁我们已经完成的工作，却要得着美满的赏赐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要小心，不要拆毁我们已经完成的工作，却要得着美满的赏赐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要小心，不要失去你们 所做的工，乃要得着满足的赏赐。
verses.textEnNiv: Watch out that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be rewarded fully.
verses.textEnEsv: Watch yourselves, so that you may not lose what we have worked for, but may win a full reward.
verses.textEnNkjv: Look to yourselves, that we do not lose those things we worked for, but that we may receive a full reward.
verses.textEnNlt: Watch out that you do not lose what we have worked so hard to achieve. Be diligent so that you receive your full reward.
verses.textEnNasb: Watch yourselves, that you do not lose what we have accomplished, but that you may receive a full reward.
verses.textEn: Watch out that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be rewarded fully.

verses.textZh: 凡越过基督的教训又不持守的，就没有神；持守这教训的，就有父和子了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡越过基督的教训又不持守的，就没有神；持守这教训的，就有父和子了。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡越过基督的教训不常守着的，就没有神；常守这教训的，就有父又有子。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who runs ahead and does not continue in the teaching of Christ does not have God; whoever continues in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
verses.textEnEsv: Everyone who goes on ahead and does not abide in the teaching of Christ, does not have God. Whoever abides in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever transgresses and does not abide in the doctrine of Christ does not have God. He who abides in the doctrine of Christ has both the Father and the Son.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who wanders away from this teaching has no relationship with God. But anyone who remains in the teaching of Christ has a relationship with both the Father and the Son.
verses.textEnNasb: Anyone who goes too far and does not remain in the teaching of Christ, does not have God; the one who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
verses.textEn: Anyone who runs ahead and does not continue in the teaching of Christ does not have God; whoever continues in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

verses.textZh: 如果有人到你们那里，不传这教训，你们就不要接待他到家里，也不要问候他；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人到你们那里，不传这教训，你们就不要接待他到家里，也不要问候他；
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人到你们那里，不是传这教训，不要接他到家里，也不要问他的安；
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not take them into your house or welcome them.
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your house or give him any greeting,
verses.textEnNkjv: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this doctrine, do not receive him into your house nor greet him;
verses.textEnNlt: If anyone comes to your meeting and does not teach the truth about Christ, don’t invite that person into your home or give any kind of encouragement.
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your house, and do not give him a greeting;
verses.textEn: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not take them into your house or welcome them.

verses.textZh: 因为问候他的，就在他的恶事上有分了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为问候他的，就在他的恶事上有分了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为问他安的，就在他的恶行上有分。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who welcomes them shares in their wicked work.
verses.textEnEsv: for whoever greets him takes part in his wicked works.
verses.textEnNkjv: for he who greets him shares in his evil deeds.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who encourages such people becomes a partner in their evil work.
verses.textEnNasb: for the one who gives him a greeting participates in his evil deeds.
verses.textEn: Anyone who welcomes them shares in their wicked work.

verses.textZh: 我还有许多话要写给你们，可是我不想借用纸墨，只是盼望到你们那里当面谈谈，好让我们的喜乐充足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我还有许多话要写给你们，可是我不想借用纸墨，只是盼望到你们那里当面谈谈，好让我们的喜乐充足。
verses.textZhCuv: 我还有许多事要写给你们，却不愿意用纸墨写出来，但盼望到你们那里，与你们当面谈论，使你们的喜乐满足。
verses.textEnNiv: I have much to write to you, but I do not want to use paper and ink. Instead, I hope to visit you and talk with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
verses.textEnEsv: Though I have much to write to you, I would rather not use paper and ink. Instead I hope to come to you and talk face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
verses.textEnNkjv: Having many things to write to you, I did not wish todoso with paper and ink; but I hope to come to you and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
verses.textEnNlt: I have much more to say to you, but I don’t want to do it with paper and ink. For I hope to visit you soon and talk with you face to face. Then our joy will be complete.
verses.textEnNasb: Though I have many things to write to you, I do not want to do so with paper and ink; but I hope to come to you and speak face to face, so that your joy may be made complete.
verses.textEn: I have much to write to you, but I do not want to use paper and ink. Instead, I hope to visit you and talk with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.

verses.textZh: 你那蒙拣选的姊妹的儿女都问候你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你那蒙拣选的姊妹的儿女都问候你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你那蒙拣选之姊妹的儿女都问你安。
verses.textEnNiv: The children of your sister, who is chosen by God, send their greetings.
verses.textEnEsv: The children of your elect sister greet you.
verses.textEnNkjv: The children of your elect sister greet you. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: Greetings from the children of your sister, chosen by God.
verses.textEnNasb: The children of your chosen sister greet you.
verses.textEn: The children of your sister, who is chosen by God, send their greetings.
